'''Grayda Paro''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|female]]. Following the [[Battle of Asylum]] she traveled to [[Odessen]] and joined the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] against the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. She was assigned to the [[Force Enclave]] branch of the Alliance under [[Sana-Rae]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Grayda Paro appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' expansion as a Jedi Knight vendor inside [[Alliance base|Odessen base]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
